# Road Less Traveled

> Luxury bayfront vacation rental in Galveston, Texas. 4 bedrooms, 4 ensuite bathrooms, sleeps 16. Hot tub, private boardwalk over West Bay, pet friendly. Ideal for large families, multi-family groups, family reunions, fishing trips, and company retreats.

## Property Facts

- **Name:** Road Less Traveled
- **Location:** Galveston Bay Club community, Galveston, Texas (West Bay / Gulf Coast)
- **Website:** https://stayroadlesstraveled.com/
- **Bedrooms:** 4 (all ensuite)
- **Bathrooms:** 4 (all ensuite)
- **Sleeps:** Up to 16 guests
- **Bed configuration:** 2 King beds, 2 Queen beds, 2 full-over-full bunks, 1 twin-over-twin bunk nook
- **Rating:** 4.86 stars across 178 reviews (Airbnb, VRBO, Booking.com combined)
- **Pet policy:** Pet friendly, up to 3 pets, $25 fee per pet
- **Parking:** 5 vehicles on-site

## Amenities

- Private hot tub with bay views
- Private boardwalk extending over Galveston Bay (fishing-friendly)
- Three covered balconies
- Gourmet kitchen with marble island and wine fridge
- High-speed WiFi + Roku streaming in every room
- Beach gear rental available via BeachBox

## Location Highlights

- Pirates Beach: 5 minutes
- The Strand Historic District: 10 minutes
- Pleasure Pier: 10 minutes
- Houston (museums, NASA, dining): 50 minutes

## Booking

- Direct booking: https://stayroadlesstraveled.com/#book (best rate, no platform fees)
- Also listed on Airbnb, VRBO, and Booking.com
- Property management by BeachBox: https://booking.staybeachbox.com/listings/204932

## Ideal Guests

- Large families (up to 16 guests)
- Multi-family group vacations
- Family reunions
